id: 03_Safety Quiz on National Safety Day Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safet
title: 安全日问答：别国的安全日和我们的安全月（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/03_Safety Quiz on National Safety Day Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safet.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/03_Safety Quiz on National Safety Day Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safet（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 印度安全理事会何时成立
points.K3: 印度国家安全日是哪天
points.S2: 国内监管与高校三级管理
points.S4: 实验室安全活动月怎么办
points.S5: 健康的实验室：职业健康与人机工效

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，背景是地球和握在一起的手的图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium in front of a globe icon held up by many hands and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天的问答，讲讲别国的安全日。
overlay: 安全日问答：别国的安全日和我们的安全月

shots.scene: 日历图标，两个日期被圈出：一个三月，一个六月
shots.prompt_en: A blank calendar with two months circled, one in early spring and one in summer. No text. No people.
shots.narration: 再看看我们自己的安全宣传活动。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验楼大厅看到“安全月”空白海报，耸肩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees a blank safety month poster in the laboratory building lobby and shrugs.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：安全月？不就是挂横幅嘛。

shots.scene: 小研笑着摇头，拿出一张空白问答卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head with a smile and holds up a blank quiz card.
shots.narration: 小研说：先答几道题，再看有什么用。

shots.scene: 问答台上十张空白题卡排开
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank question cards laid out in a row on the quiz podium. No people.
shots.narration: 国外有个国家安全日，出了十道题。

shots.scene: 阿杰托腮思考，头顶倒计时图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student thinks with his chin in his hand; a countdown timer icon above his head.
shots.narration: 每题先想一想，再公布答案。

shots.section_title: 印度安全理事会何时成立
shots.scene: 一座建筑图标，屋顶飘着空白旗子，旁边日历
shots.prompt_en: A building icon with a blank flag on the roof next to a blank calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：印度国家安全理事会何时成立？
overlay: 印度安全理事会何时成立

shots.section_title: 印度安全理事会何时成立
shots.scene: 日历翻到三月四日，年份牌显示1966
shots.prompt_en: A blank calendar flips to early March. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是一九六六年三月四日。

shots.section_title: 印度国家安全日是哪天
shots.scene: 一面空白旗子升起，周围有人鼓掌的图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank flag being raised on a pole with clapping hands icons around it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：哪一天定为国家安全日？
overlay: 印度国家安全日是哪天

shots.section_title: 印度国家安全日是哪天
shots.scene: 日历同一天被圈出，旁边写着1972
shots.prompt_en: The same day on the calendar is circled with a festive ribbon. No people.
shots.narration: 从一九七二年起，每年三月四日。

shots.section_title: 印度国家安全日是哪天
shots.scene: 成立日和安全日两个日历并排，连线
shots.prompt_en: Two calendars side by side joined by a line, both showing the same day. No people.
shots.narration: 安全日就定在理事会成立的那一天。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一块空白牌子，三个图标：握手、种子长成树、灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank board with three icons: a handshake, a seedling growing into a tree and a light bulb.
shots.narration: 第三题：设立安全日为了什么？

shots.scene: 老板和员工两个人形图标一起举手宣誓
shots.prompt_en: Two figure icons, an employer and an employee, raise their hands together as if making a promise. No people.
shots.narration: 提醒单位和员工，履行安全责任和承诺。

shots.scene: 一棵树的根伸进工厂、办公室、学校各种建筑
shots.prompt_en: A tree whose roots spread under a factory, an office, a school and a small shop. No people.
shots.narration: 让安全文化扎根各行各业。

shots.scene: 实验室、办公室这些没有危险图标的建筑也被树根连上
shots.prompt_en: The roots also reach a quiet office and a laboratory building without hazard icons. No people.
shots.narration: 不只危险行业，法规没覆盖的地方也要。

shots.scene: 灯泡亮起，事故图标被挡在盾牌外
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb lights up while an accident icon bounces off a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 提高安全意识，避免意外事故。

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three icons receive green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 三条都对，答案是以上全部。

shots.scene: 三栋政府大楼图标，各插空白旗子
shots.prompt_en: Three government building icons, each with a blank flag. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：理事会是哪个部门设立的？

shots.scene: 有工人安全帽图标的大楼亮起
shots.prompt_en: The building with a hard hat icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是劳动部门。

shots.scene: 两本空白法规书，一个登记印章盖在中间
shots.prompt_en: Two blank law books with a registration stamp pressed between them. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：理事会按什么法律登记？

shots.scene: 两本书都亮起，印章打勾
shots.prompt_en: Both books light up and the stamp shows a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 社团登记和公共信托两部法律，两者都是。

shots.scene: 非营利组织图标：手拉手的人形
shots.prompt_en: An icon of linked hands forming a circle, representing a non-profit society. No people.
shots.narration: 它是一个登记注册的非营利组织。

shots.scene: 地图轮廓上一个大圆点，代表全国
shots.prompt_en: A blank country map outline with one large dot in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：理事会在全国层面做什么？

shots.scene: 讲台、书本、柱状图三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a lecture podium, a stack of blank booklets and a bar chart. No people.
shots.narration: 办研讨会，出安全资料，发布统计数据。

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three icons get green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是以上全部。

shots.scene: 地图上几个小圆点，代表各地
shots.prompt_en: The country map outline with several small dots across regions. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：在地方层面做什么？

shots.scene: 不同颜色的对话气泡、海报、小册子图标
shots.prompt_en: Speech bubbles in different colors, blank posters and small blank booklets. No people.
shots.narration: 用当地语言办活动、发海报、印手册。

shots.scene: 手册打开，里面是打勾的好做法图标
shots.prompt_en: An open blank booklet showing icons of good practices with check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 把好的安全做法，讲给当地人听。

shots.scene: 一座工厂图标，门口站着几名员工
shots.prompt_en: A factory gate with a few workers gathered at the entrance.
shots.narration: 第八题：在企业层面做什么？

shots.scene: 员工举手宣誓，手里拿着空白誓词卡
shots.prompt_en: Workers raise their right hands holding blank pledge cards.
shots.narration: 编写和分发安全誓词，大家一起宣誓。

shots.scene: 升起一面空白旗帜
shots.prompt_en: A blank flag is raised on a pole at the factory yard.
shots.narration: 升起安全日的旗帜。

shots.scene: 展板和抢答台的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of blank exhibition boards and a quiz buzzer. No people.
shots.narration: 办安全竞赛和展览。答案是全部。

shots.scene: 一座灯塔，光照向工厂、办公室、绿树
shots.prompt_en: A lighthouse shining its light toward a factory, an office and green trees. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：理事会的愿景是什么？

shots.scene: 三个图标：盾牌、心形、绿叶
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a shield, a heart and a green leaf. No people.
shots.narration: 提供指导和服务，让工作场所更安全、

shots.scene: 心形和绿叶亮起
shots.prompt_en: The heart and the leaf icons glow. No people.
shots.narration: 更健康、更环保，做全国的领先者。

shots.scene: 一个会议桌图标，周围不同国家的小旗（空白）
shots.prompt_en: A round conference table icon surrounded by small blank flags. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：它办过几次国际会议？

shots.scene: 五根手指的手势图标
shots.prompt_en: A hand icon showing five fingers. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答案是五次，这个数会变。

shots.scene: 小研摊手，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shrugs with a question mark icon beside her.
shots.narration: 这类数字知道就好，不必死记。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本日历，几个月份被圈出
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a big blank calendar with several months circled.
shots.narration: 我国也有一串安全宣传的日子。

shots.scene: 六月整页亮起，横幅图标
shots.prompt_en: One month page lights up with a banner icon. No text. No people.
shots.narration: 每年六月，是全国安全生产月。

shots.scene: 消防车和119电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fire truck and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 十一月九日，是消防宣传日。

shots.scene: 房屋和地震波图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a house and seismic waves with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 五月十二日，是防灾减灾日。

shots.scene: 安全帽加心形，四月日历
shots.prompt_en: A hard hat icon with a heart on a calendar page. No people.
shots.narration: 四月最后一周，是职业病防治法宣传周。

shots.scene: 王老师指着日历，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at the calendar with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 具体安排，以当年官方通知为准。

shots.section_title: 国内监管与高校三级管理
shots.scene: 几个部门大楼图标连成网
shots.prompt_en: Several government building icons connected in a network. No people.
shots.narration: 国内有专门部门监管安全和职业健康。
overlay: 国内监管与高校三级管理

shots.section_title: 国内监管与高校三级管理
shots.scene: 三级台阶：学校、学院、实验室
shots.prompt_en: Three steps with icons: a university building, a faculty building and a laboratory flask. No people.
shots.narration: 高校实行学校、学院、实验室三级管理。

shots.section_title: 国内监管与高校三级管理
shots.scene: 老周站在实验室门口，胸前挂空白牌子
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at a laboratory door wearing a blank responsibility badge.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人，是第一责任人。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在几本空白法规书旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside several thick blank law books.
shots.narration: 安全生产法要求全员安全生产责任制。

shots.scene: 从负责人到学生，每人头顶一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A line of people from the older man to the young male student, each with a small shield icon above the head.
shots.narration: 从负责人到每个学生，人人有责。

shots.scene: 阿杰签署空白安全承诺书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank safety commitment form at a desk.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，签安全承诺、通过准入考试。

shots.scene: 王老师合上法规书，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator closes a blank rule book with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 具体条款，以现行文本和本校规定为准。

shots.section_title: 实验室安全活动月怎么办
shots.scene: 实验楼门口挂起空白横幅，学生陆续进来
shots.prompt_en: A blank banner hangs over the laboratory building entrance as students walk in.
shots.narration: 实验室安全月，可以这样办：
overlay: 实验室安全活动月怎么办

shots.section_title: 实验室安全活动月怎么办
shots.scene: 学生在楼道里进行疏散演练
shots.prompt_en: Students walk calmly along a corridor following green exit arrows during a drill.
shots.narration: 组织应急疏散和灭火演练。

shots.section_title: 实验室安全活动月怎么办
shots.scene: 老周和小研拿着空白检查表检查通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student inspect a fume hood with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 开展隐患自查，发现问题就整改。

shots.section_title: 实验室安全活动月怎么办
shots.scene: 抢答台前几队学生比赛
shots.prompt_en: Teams of students compete at a quiz buzzer table.
shots.narration: 办知识竞赛，答完要讲清道理。

shots.section_title: 健康的实验室：职业健康与人机工效
shots.scene: 愿景里的心形图标放大
shots.prompt_en: The heart icon from the vision grows larger. No people.
shots.narration: “更健康”，也包括实验室里的工效。
overlay: 健康的实验室：职业健康与人机工效

shots.section_title: 健康的实验室：职业健康与人机工效
shots.scene: 小研调整座椅和台面高度，屏幕与视线齐平
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts her chair so her forearms are level with the bench and the monitor is at eye level.
shots.narration: 座椅、台面、屏幕高度要合适。

shots.section_title: 健康的实验室：职业健康与人机工效
shots.scene: 阿杰长时间移液，手腕红色疼痛图标；然后伸展手腕
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pipettes for a long time with a red pain icon on his wrist, then stretches his wrists.
shots.narration: 重复操作要定时休息、活动手腕。

shots.section_title: 健康的实验室：职业健康与人机工效
shots.scene: 接触有害因素的人员做体检的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a medical checkup with a stethoscope and a blank form. No people.
shots.narration: 接触职业病危害的，按规定做健康检查。

shots.scene: 小研在空白记录本上登记一处松动的插座
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student notes a loose wall socket in a blank log book.
shots.narration: 发现隐患，及时登记上报。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告一次险情
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports a near miss to the older man.
shots.narration: 未遂事件和小伤，也要报告。

shots.scene: 柱状图逐年下降
shots.prompt_en: A bar chart with bars getting shorter year by year. No people.
shots.narration: 统计分析，才知道哪里需要改进。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在日历和地球之间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a calendar and a globe.
shots.narration: 回顾一下今天的问答。

shots.scene: 握手、树根、灯泡三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a handshake, spreading tree roots and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 安全日的意义：责任、文化、意识。

shots.scene: 安全生产月、消防日、防灾日图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a banner, a fire truck and a house with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 记住我国的安全宣传节点。

shots.scene: 阿杰把安全承诺书贴在实验台旁，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pins a blank commitment form beside his bench and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：安全月，原来人人都有事做。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside the quiz podium.
shots.narration: 天天都是安全日，下次见！
